title: BridgeBuilder Network
body: A growing network of young people building small bridges in their own neighborhoods.

title: BridgeBuilder Virtual Lab
body: Online labs where BridgeBuilders across countries share what they’re discovering, every two months.

title: Sindhuli Storytelling Festival
body: The StoryCycle group, led by Saurav Dhakal, is preparing a festival to celebrate the folk stories of Sindhuli village, connecting elders and youth.

title: Yamaguchi Family Festival
body: A family-focused community in Yamaguchi City uses music and song to support children’s spiritual wellbeing — learning, practicing, and celebrating life together.

title: Junior Youth Space
body: Young people from many nationalities gather for meaningful conversation on virtues and community wellbeing, designing their own neighborhood service projects — a model of belonging that doesn’t require sameness.

title: Animators in Caotun
body: Junior Youth animators are becoming an everyday presence in Caotun’s schools and neighborhoods, and Möbius Making was delivered in Chinese to high schoolers and teachers — the practice travels across language.

title: “Perhaps we were already connected.”
body: A participant reflection carried out of a ME=WE Core session.

title: Two hands, one line
body: A drawing made during Möbius Making — where the ME and WE surfaces became one.

title: Food Revolution
body: KULNA Community Garden — a social lab that began as a classroom experiment in growing and sharing food together.
